items.title: Open Standard issues dollar stablecoin backed by Visa, Stripe, and Mastercard
items.summary: Investing.com -- A consortium backed by payment giants including Visa Inc (NYSE:V), Stripe Inc., and Mastercard Inc (NYSE:MA) has officially launched a new US dollar-pegged stablecoin, marking one of the most concerted traditional finance pushes to date into digital currency infrastructure.

items.title: Apple Pay launches in India with Axis Bank partnership
items.summary: The rollout is limited to Axis Bank Visa and Mastercard credit cards at launch, entering a market dominated by UPI, Google Pay, and PhonePe

items.title: Mastercard Stock Is Flat Over The Past Year, Does MA Have Room To Run By 2028?
items.summary: Key Takeaways:Agentic Commerce: Mastercard launched Agent Pay for Machines, the only network protocol enabling AI agents to make purchases at machine speed, opening a new addressable market. Price Projection: Based on current assumptions, MA stock could reach $800 by December 2028.

items.title: AI shopping agents need receipts
items.summary: As artificial intelligence assumes a bigger role in commerce and finances, having a clear record of agents’ actions is critical, executives said.

items.title: Apple Launches Mobile Payment Services in India
items.summary: Users in India can now use Apple Pay on iPhones, iPads and Apple Watches via a partnership with Axis Bank, one of the largest private-sector lenders in the country.

items.title: Apple Pay finally launches in India after years on the sidelines
items.summary: Some of India's largest banks are holding off on supporting Apple Pay initially.

items.title: Going Rogue and Getting a Wallet: The $53 Billion AI Commerce Crisis No One Is Ready For
items.summary: AI agents are already swiping cards, placing orders, and flooding complaint systems, and Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Shopify are all racing to build guardrails for a trust problem that has no agreed-upon solution yet.
